title: Synonyms
description: Generic zsh/English synonym data. Two disjoint mechanisms — see `synonyms.yaml` for the contract. Authored blind to the eval sets (see `NLP.md`).

index_groups.description: Symmetric, index-time. If any member matches a record (whole word / phrase), the others are appended to its `expanded` view before embedding (see `retrieval_text.rs`). May be empty.

query_expansions.description: Directional, query-time, embedding-only. Maps colloquial query vocabulary onto the corpus's canonical term (see `query_expand.rs`).

QueryExpansion.description: One directional query rule: when any `when` trigger matches the query, the single canonical `add` term is appended to the *embedded* query string only (never the lexical-overlap bag — keeps short queries from being swamped).

when.description: Colloquial trigger words / phrases (matched whole word / phrase). Any casing; normalized to lowercase at load.

add.description: Canonical term appended for embedding. One term by design; any casing, normalized to lowercase at load.
